sanskrit: asmin vasu vasavo dhārayantv indras tvaṣṭā varuṇo mitro agniḥ | imam ādityā uta viśve ca devā uttame devā jyotiṣi dhārayantu ||
english: May the Vasus establish wealth in this one — Indra, Tvaṣṭṛ, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni; may the Ādityas and all the gods sustain him in the highest divine light.

sanskrit: asmai devāḥ pradiśaj jyotir astu sūryo agnir uta vā hiraṇyam | uttareṇa brahmaṇā vi bhāhi kṛṇvāno anyān adharān sapatnān ||
english: For him let the gods grant splendor in the quarters — the sun, fire, and gold; shine forth with the superior brahman-power, making rivals lower than yourself.

sanskrit: yenendrāya samabharaṃ payāṃsy uttareṇa brahmaṇā jātavedaḥ | tena tvam agna iha vardhayemaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ śraiṣṭhyam ā dhehy asmai ||
english: O Jātavedas, by the same superior brahman-power with which you gathered the vital essences for Indra — by that, O Agni, increase this man here; bestow upon him the fullness of riches and sovereignty.

sanskrit: aiṣāṃ yajñam uta varco bhare 'haṃ rāyaspoṣam uta vittāny agne | sapatnā asmad adhare bhavantu- -uttame devā jyotiṣi dhattanemam ||
english: I carry off the sacrifice and the vigor of these foes, O Agni — the fullness of riches and their possessions; let the rivals be lower than us; O gods, establish this man in the highest light.

sanskrit: mā no vidan vivyādhino mo abhivyādhino vidan | ārāc charavyā asmad viṣūcīr indra pātaya ||
english: Let not the piercers find us, let not the smiting archers find us; O Indra, strike far from us the scattering volleys of arrows.

sanskrit: viṣvañco asmac charavaḥ patantu ye astā ye cāsyāḥ | devā manuṣyā ṛṣayo 'mitrān no vi vidhyatu ||
english: Let the arrows shot from all directions fall away from us — those discharged and those yet to be discharged; may gods, mortals, and seers pierce our enemies.

sanskrit: yaḥ samāno yo 'samāno 'mitro no jighāṃsati | rudraḥ śaravyayā tān amitrān no vi vidhyatu ||
english: The enemy, whether known to us or unknown, who seeks to slay us — may Rudra with his arrows pierce those foes of ours.

sanskrit: sabandhuś cāsabandhuś ca yo na indrābhidāsati | devās taṃ sarve dhūrvantu brahma varma mamāntaram ||
english: Whether kinsman or stranger who plots harm against us, O Indra — let all the gods shatter him; the sacred formula is my innermost armor.

sanskrit: nāsaṃ naśan svayaṃ srasann asatībhyo asattarāḥ | sehor arasatarā lavaṇād vikledīyasīḥ ||
english: Not yet perished, falling away of themselves, more unreal than unreal things — more sapless than the sehora plant, more withered than salt: [thus depart, O apacit growths].

sanskrit: apacitaḥ pra patata suparṇo vasater iva | sūryaḥ kṛṇotu bheṣajaṃ candramā vo 'pocchatu ||
english: Fall away, O apacit growths, as a bird flies from its nest; may the Sun make the remedy, and may the Moon drive you away.

sanskrit: eny ekā śyeny ekā kṛṣṇaikā rohiṇī dve | sarvāsām agrabhaṃ nāma- -avīraghnīr apetana ||
english: One is spotted, one is tawny, one is black, two are ruddy — I have seized the name of all of them; O ones that slay no hero, depart.

sanskrit: asūtikā rāmāyaṇy apacit pra patiṣyati | glaur itaḥ pra patiṣyati sa galanto naśiṣyati ||
english: The unborn, the dark wanderer — the apacit will fly away; the glaur will fly away from here; that which dissolves shall perish.

sanskrit: apeto apacitvarīr indraḥ pūṣā ca cikyatuḥ | apetv asya grīvābhyo apa padbhyāṃ vijāmataḥ ||
english: Depart, O female apacit growths — Indra and Pūṣan have perceived you; depart from his neck, depart from his feet, O ones who estrange kinsmen.
